name: nutri-mcp
description: Food nutrition, Nutri-Score, Green-Score, allergens, diets, prices and recalls by barcode.
long_description: Look up packaged foods by barcode or name and get nutrients per 100 g and per serving, Nutri-Score (2023) and Green-Score grades, NOVA processing level, allergens (FDA Big 9 / EU 14), diet compatibility, additives, crowdsourced prices (Open Prices) and US FDA recalls. Data from Open Food Facts, with optional USDA FoodData Central and Nutritionix enrichment.

off_contact_email.title: Contact email (optional)
off_contact_email.description: Sent in the User-Agent; Open Food Facts asks API users to identify themselves.

usda_api_key.title: USDA FoodData Central API key (optional)
usda_api_key.description: Free key from https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup - adds US branded food data.
